categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the high-end intelligent equipment sector, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of CNC machine tools. Its product portfolio includes five-axis machining centers, horizontal machining centers, drilling and milling centers, vertical machining centers, gantry machining centers, CNC lathes, precision engraving machines, Swiss-type lathes, and profile machining centers. It also provides integrated intelligent equipment solutions and digital manufacturing platforms such as the 'Machine Tool Cloud' platform.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes advanced CNC technologies including five-axis linkage, high-speed and high-precision machining, and digital twin virtual machining. It employs modular, standardized, and lean production processes with rigorous quality control supported by advanced imported inspection instruments. The R&D approach integrates whole-machine development with key component innovation, including independent development of spindles, tool magazines, rotary tables, and secondary development of CNC systems. The company also leverages digital simulation and industrial internet platforms for product upgrades.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in the 3C (computer, communication, consumer electronics) industry, automotive (especially new energy vehicles), aerospace, robotics, semiconductor, and general manufacturing sectors. The company serves major brands such as BYD Electronics, Foxconn, Lingyi iTech, Luxshare Precision, CRRC, SAIC General Motors, AVIC, and Yushi Technology. It also targets emerging markets like AI hardware, humanoid robots, and low-altitude economy sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Shenzhen, Dongguan, Suzhou, Huzhou, and Yibin, covering key manufacturing clusters in South China, East China, and Southwest China. It has expanded overseas with subsidiaries and production facilities in Vietnam and Hong Kong, and actively develops markets in Southeast Asia, Europe, and Latin America.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the CNC machine tool supply chain, focusing on final assembly, integration, and sales of high-end intelligent equipment. It sources core components through strategic procurement and outsourcing rather than heavy asset investment in upstream raw materials or parts manufacturing, maintaining control over design and quality while mitigating operational risks.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening technology innovation, expanding the product matrix especially in high-end five-axis CNC machines, and achieving core component self-sufficiency. The company invests in digitalization, intelligent manufacturing, and customized solutions for new energy vehicles and emerging industries. It also pursues global marketing network expansion and smart factory construction to enhance production efficiency and competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of CNC machine tools and intelligent equipment solutions. The company also earns income from equipment leasing and after-sales services. It leverages government subsidies and investment income from financial products as supplementary revenue sources.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic high-end CNC machine tool manufacturer in China, competing against international brands from Japan, Germany, and the US. It holds a strong market share in the 3C sector and is advancing in import substitution for high-end CNC machines. Its comprehensive product range and integrated solutions provide competitive advantages in both domestic and international markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 4.6 billion, a 30.49% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 237 million, up 22%. It has total assets exceeding RMB 10.6 billion and net assets of about RMB 5.06 billion. The company shows a positive growth trajectory supported by expanding sales volume, increased production capacity, and rising overseas revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high precision, efficiency, reliability, and cost-effectiveness in its intelligent equipment offerings. Its broad product portfolio covers diverse machining needs with advanced five-axis and multi-axis capabilities. The integration of digital platforms like 'Machine Tool Cloud' and virtual machining simulation enhances customer production management and reduces costs. Strong R&D and localized service networks further differentiate the company by delivering tailored, innovative solutions that support customers' intelligent manufacturing transformation.
